column1: # Accepted CodeQL findings. The gate in pr-checks.yml ignores exactly
# these, and nothing else. Changing this file takes a pull request.

column3: The Reolink firmware takes the session token as a query parameter on GET (Snap, Download, /flv) and has no header alternative; the simulator must accept it the same way. Tokens are never logged: request records keep the path without the query (test/redaction.test.ts).

The simulated camera API reproduces the firmware, which does not rate-limit; cam-sim is a test tool, and rate limiting would change what clients under test see. The control API needs a bearer token compared in constant time.
Test-only: connects to the simulator's self-signed factory certificate on purpose, to read back which certificate is being served.
Test-only: connects to the control port's self-signed factory certificate on purpose, to read back which certificate is being served.
The reboot duration is clamped to 0-600000 ms in Engine.reboot() and validated by the control API, which needs the bearer token; a simulated reboot of at most ten minutes is the intended feature.
deepMerge() skips __proto__, constructor and prototype keys explicitly before any assignment or recursion; covered by 'ignores prototype keys' in test/settings.test.ts.

ONVIF WS-UsernameToken PasswordDigest is defined by the standard as base64(sha1(nonce + created + password)); the camera and every ONVIF client use it, so the simulator must verify it that way. It is compared in constant time, with a 5-minute Created window. Passwords are not stored hashed with it.
Test-only: builds a WS-UsernameToken PasswordDigest the way ONVIF clients do (SHA-1 is mandated by the standard) to sign in to the simulator.

Intended: ffmpeg unescapes a filter option value twice (the filter-graph level: backslash, quote, brackets, comma, semicolon; then the option level: backslash, quote, colon), so q() escapes for the option level first and then for the graph level. Covered with real ffmpeg on a folder name containing all of these characters ('takes font and text file paths with ...' in test/overlay.test.ts).
Baichuan login: the camera's protocol mandates MD5 of user/password with the nonce (reolink_aio does the same); the simulator must answer it.
